description: Defines the ProvisioningCriteriaData class, a data container for provisioning criteria in the Fineract project, including fields, constructors, static factory methods, and comparison logic.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaData
classes.description: A data class representing provisioning criteria, including collections of loan products, definitions, and GL accounts, with utility methods for creation and comparison.

methods.name: toLookup
methods.description: Creates a ProvisioningCriteriaData instance with specified criteria ID, name, loan products, and definitions.

methods.name: toTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template ProvisioningCriteriaData instance with specified definitions, loan products, and GL accounts.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ProvisioningCriteriaData instance with another based on criteriaId for ordering.
